about_the_game:
School Anomaly is a short walking-simulator horror experience set in a Japanese school corridor, inspired by Exit 8.

You arrive at school like any other day, but something feels off. No matter how far you walk, you can’t leave the corridor. The school has changed—and now you must find a way out.

Pay close attention to every detail around you.

If you spot something strange, take the stairs up.

If everything looks normal, head down the stairs on the other side.

Face a series of unsettling and ever-changing hallways.

Can you escape, or will you be trapped forever?

Game features

  • This game features a certain degree of randomness and includes over 50 different abnormal scenes for players to experience. You can't be sure what kind of crisis will come next. The corridor full of dangers tests the player's ability to adapt to changes on the spot.

  • The game features a light Rogue-like gameplay. Players will take on the role of the protagonist, investigating anomalies and finding exits in the school corridors.

  • Players must strive to identify whether there is anything abnormal in the current scene and leave through the correct exit; otherwise, they will never be able to extricate themselves from the crisis.

  • The game features a variety of terrifying and novel monster images, dedicated to creating a terrifying and eerie atmosphere.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains some mature content that may not be suitable for all viewers, including:

Minor violence; Bloody; Violent behavior; Accidental death; Physical harm; Corpse; Kill; Torture; Description of suicide; Psychological fear.

For those who may feel uncomfortable with the listed topics, please do not play the game.

This game, in order to create a terrifying atmosphere, includes terrifying elements such as skeletons, corpses, blood, and hanging, but not all map scenes contain these elements. Some maps may contain these elements for game purposes. As this game has random elements, players have a chance to see these terrifying scenes, but it's not certain.
